nodes.description: Private mapping of account balances in the ERC20 contract.
Private nested mapping storing owner->spender allowances.
Private total token supply counter.
Private token name string set in the constructor.
Private token symbol string set in the constructor.
Private decimals value fixed to 18 in the constructor.
External caller address supplied by the transaction, read via Context._msgSender or directly in the constructor.
Public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) moving tokens from the caller.
Public approve(address spender, uint256 amount) setting an allowance.
Public transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) spending a prior allowance granted by msg.sender.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) mutating balances with SafeMath.
Internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount) increasing total supply and balance.
Internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) writing the allowance mapping.
Public increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) raising the caller allowance.
Public decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) lowering the caller allowance.
MercuryCoin constructor that mints 10000000e18 tokens to the deployer.

edges.reason: _msgSender reads the untrusted msg.sender untrusted input to produce the caller identity.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender into _transfer.
approve passes _msgSender() as owner into _approve.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() to index the allowance entry that authorises spending sender tokens.
increaseAllowance uses _msgSender() to select the allowance owner slot.
decreaseAllowance uses _msgSender() to select the allowance owner slot.
MercuryCoin constructor mints the entire supply to msg.sender, making the deployer the sole privileged holder.
transfer delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
approve delegates the allowance write to _approve.
transferFrom delegates the balance mutation to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the allowance reduction to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates the allowance write to _approve.
MercuryCoin constructor invokes _mint for the initial supply.
_transfer subtracts from and adds to _balances entries using SafeMath arithmetic.
_mint adds amount to _totalSupply.
_mint adds amount to the target account balance in _balances.
_approve writes the allowance value into _allowances.
transfer.recipient flows into the transfer routine.
transfer.amount flows into the balance arithmetic.
approve.spender flows into the approval routine.
approve.amount flows into the allowance value.
transferFrom.sender is caller-supplied and only constrained by the allowance check on msg.sender.
transferFrom.recipient flows into the transfer routine.
transferFrom.amount flows into balance and allowance arithmetic.
increaseAllowance.spender flows into the approval routine.
increaseAllowance.addedValue is added to the current allowance.
decreaseAllowance.subtractedValue is subtracted from the current allowance.
_transfer.sender selects the balance to debit.
_transfer.recipient selects the balance to credit.
_transfer.amount is the value operated on by SafeMath add/sub.
_mint.account selects the balance to credit.
_mint.amount is added to total supply and balance.
sendValue.recipient determines the target of the external value call.
sendValue.amount determines the ether value forwarded by the external call.
functionCallWithValue.target determines the untrusted call destination.
functionCallWithValue.data determines the untrusted call payload.
functionCallWithValue.weiValue determines the ether value forwarded.
sendValue stores the returned success flag in the local variable.
The low-level value call can transfer control to an attacker contract that reenters public entrypoints such as transfer.
The low-level data call can transfer control to an attacker contract that reenters public entrypoints such as transfer.

normalization_plan.reason: transfer.recipient is an input local to transfer and should be folded into the transfer function node.
transfer.amount is an argument consumed only by transfer and merges into it.
approve.spender is an argument consumed only by approve and merges into it.
approve.amount is an argument consumed only by approve and merges into it.
transferFrom.sender is an argument consumed only by transferFrom and merges into it.
transferFrom.recipient is an argument consumed only by transferFrom and merges into it.
transferFrom.amount is an argument consumed only by transferFrom and merges into it.
increaseAllowance.spender is an argument consumed only by increaseAllowance and merges into it.
increaseAllowance.addedValue is an argument consumed only by increaseAllowance and merges into it.
decreaseAllowance.subtractedValue is an argument consumed only by decreaseAllowance and merges into it.
_transfer.sender is an internal argument consumed only by _transfer and merges into it.
_transfer.recipient is an internal argument consumed only by _transfer and merges into it.
_transfer.amount is an internal argument consumed only by _transfer and merges into it.
_mint.account is an internal argument consumed only by _mint and merges into it.
_mint.amount is an internal argument consumed only by _mint and merges into it.
sendValue.recipient directly parameterises the unsafe low-level call and merges into it.
sendValue.amount directly parameterises the value of the unsafe low-level call and merges into it.
functionCallWithValue.target directly parameterises the unsafe low-level call and merges into it.

sendValue.success is the result flag of the unsafe call and merges into that operation node.
